_note: Fight tuning. The field is 16 tiles wide and 20 long (bigger for big herds: draft_rules.json "field"). Times are in seconds, distances in tiles, speeds in tiles per minute. An animal heading for a target that's still fine looks around for a better one every retarget_seconds (keeps big fights cheap on phones), and only switches to one that's clearly better: food bait, the class it goes after, an enemy already in reach, or one at least retarget_margin_tiles closer (so animals don't dither between two enemies).

army._note: Armies in Draft Duel (scripts/battle/battle_army.gd). Each army's front line starts start_gap tiles from the middle and marches at march_pace (tiles per minute) with everyone in step; an animal out of its place catches up at catch_up_pct of the pace (or its own speed if faster). The front holds while its first rank has an enemy within engage tiles, and never comes closer than contact_gap tiles to the enemy's front line (the lines meet, they don't pass through each other). Ranged ranks stop to shoot while an enemy is in reach and fire together every volley_seconds (each shot carries the damage of the time between volleys), the first volley first_volley_seconds after one comes into reach. clash: the moment the front lines meet. charge_after_seconds after the clash, Tank Destroyers charge the enemy Tanks (charge_speed_pct of their speed, no leash) and go back to their line once none are left. When animals fall, the ranks close up every repack_seconds. From the clash on, it's all-out war (see war, below): nobody keeps its place. lane_pct: how much an enemy off to the side of an animal's place counts as further away (keeps lines fighting straight across). damage_pct: every army animal's bite, as a share of its card's (with its squad's share on top): sets how long fights take.

war._note: All-out war (battle_army.gd): from the clash, or once a front has been held up by a fight for after_hold_seconds, nobody keeps its place or waits. Every animal goes for an enemy anywhere on the field. A fighter (reach under shooter_reach tiles) takes an open spot next to its target, checked every spot_seconds; each teammate already on that enemy makes it count crowd_cost tiles further away, and full_cost more once there's no room left around it, so attackers spread along the whole enemy line. Walking there, it looks look_ahead tiles ahead and passes anyone in its way (teammates, and enemies it isn't after) with pass_margin tiles to spare, on round the same side to the end of a line; once it steps aside, it keeps on to the spot beside them for up to detour_seconds (rather than turning straight back into them). It only switches to another enemy (not yet in reach) at least switch_margin tiles nearer. Shooters close in until they're in reach; nothing blocks their shots.
